name: pumasi-sign
description: Not the product's package. This file exists so that pumasi/tools/gate.sh -- the charter's executable merge gate, whose step 1 runs `npm test` at the repository root -- runs this repository's real suite instead of failing on a missing package.json, the way pumasi-tunnel/package.json does. It deliberately carries NO `version` field: one version number, in the root package.json, user-visible and in every feedback report, is PRODUCT-RULES.md PR-1 and roadmap/BACKLOG.md item 6, and setting it here would take the product manager's next item in a packet scoped to item 1. The suite below is what runs without Postgres or Docker; backend pytest (needs Postgres on :5433) and the Playwright e2e job (needs the built container) are gated by .github/workflows/ci.yaml, which is where the whole suite actually runs. That split is stated rather than left for a reader to discover.

scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test:unit && npm --prefix frontend exec -- vue-tsc --noEmit -p frontend/tsconfig.json
